skill.name: tailwind
skill.description: Tailwind CSS v4.2 browser-runtime patterns for HyperFrames compositions. Use when scaffolding or editing projects created with `hyperframes init --tailwind`, writing Tailwind utility classes in composition HTML, adding CSS-first Tailwind v4 theme tokens, debugging v3 vs v4 syntax, or deciding when to compile Tailwind to CSS instead of using the browser runtime.
skill.summary: Guides Tailwind CSS v4 browser-runtime usage in HyperFrames compositions.
skill.author: heygen-com

content.value_statement: Tailwind v4 browser-runtime projects can fail when teams apply older v3 patterns. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code precise HyperFrames guidance for stable styling.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use Tailwind v4 browser runtime in HyperFrames compositions.
Documents the pinned Tailwind browser runtime and readiness expectations.
Shows CSS-first theme token and custom utility patterns for Tailwind v4.
Guides deterministic class usage for frame capture and video rendering.
Lists validation and render proof commands for HyperFrames projects.
limitations: Does not install Tailwind, HyperFrames, or project dependencies.
Does not replace official Tailwind documentation for full API coverage.
Focuses on HyperFrames composition HTML, not the Studio package internals.
Browser-runtime guidance may not fit production builds that require compiled CSS.

use_cases.title: Scaffold Tailwind Compositions
use_cases.description: Create HyperFrames composition HTML that uses Tailwind v4 browser-runtime patterns from the start.

use_cases.title: Migrate v3 Styling Habits
use_cases.description: Replace older config and directive patterns with CSS-first Tailwind v4 theme and utility guidance.

use_cases.title: Debug Render Styling
use_cases.description: Find missing styles, dynamic class issues, and readiness problems before frame capture.

prompt_templates.title: Start A Tailwind Scene
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new composition.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a HyperFrames composition plan that uses Tailwind v4 browser-runtime styling. Include stable layout choices and theme token guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Review Existing Classes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this HyperFrames composition for Tailwind v4 browser-runtime issues. Check dynamic classes, readiness assumptions, and v3-only patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Render Style Flashes
prompt_templates.prompt: Help diagnose missing Tailwind styles during HyperFrames rendering. Focus on runtime readiness, visible class tokens, and deterministic first-frame output.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Compiled CSS Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a migration path from Tailwind browser runtime to compiled CSS for a HyperFrames composition that must render offline.

output_examples.input: A HyperFrames scene has custom colors in a Tailwind config file.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends moving custom tokens into a CSS-first Tailwind v4 theme block for browser-runtime compositions.

output_examples.input: A render has styles in preview but missing styles at frame zero.
output_examples.output: The skill checks Tailwind readiness, visible class tokens, and validation steps before recommending a render proof.

output_examples.input: A composition builds class names from variables during animation.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends complete class tokens, data attributes, or explicit CSS so Tailwind can generate styles before capture.

best_practices: Keep render-critical Tailwind class tokens visible before validation.
Use CSS-first theme tokens and custom utilities for Tailwind v4 browser-runtime work.
Run HyperFrames validation and a short render proof after styling changes.
anti_patterns: Adding v3 Tailwind directives to browser-runtime composition CSS.
Generating important class names only during seek-time animation.
Using browser runtime for locked-down production renders that need compiled CSS.

faq.question: Does this skill target Tailwind v4 or v3?
faq.answer: It targets Tailwind v4.2 browser-runtime usage for HyperFrames compositions.

faq.question: Can it help with HyperFrames Studio internals?
faq.answer: No. The skill says Studio still uses Tailwind v3 patterns and is outside this scope.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: No for the guidance itself. It references Tailwind documentation and discusses the pinned browser runtime.

faq.question: Can it generate production CSS builds?
faq.answer: It can plan when compiled CSS is better, but it does not provide a full build system.

faq.question: Why avoid dynamic Tailwind class names?
faq.answer: Tailwind must see full class tokens before capture to generate stable styles.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
